mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.workflow_version_id, e.source_node_id, e.target_node_id, source.node_key AS source_node_key, target.node_key AS target_node_key, e.branch_key, e.sort_order, e.created_at FROM workflow_edge e JOIN workflow_node source ON source.id = e.source_node_id JOIN workflow_node target ON target.id = e.target_node_id WHERE e.workflow_version_id = #{workflowVersionId} ORDER BY e.source_node_id, e.sort_order, e.id
